entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Planeswalker native to Corondor on Dominaria, later one of the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Planeswalker who loved Kristina and banished Sandruu.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Kristina's student and lover who became a planeswalker; father of Justina.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Summoned an elder dragon against Kristina; defeated.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Threatened the Gathering of Minorad with the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Killed Kristina on Phyrexia before betraying the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Broke the Treaty of the Shard.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Deceased; Kristina's hair color perhaps in her memory.

entities.name: Parcher
entities.description: Insane planeswalker replaced by Kristina among the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Trapped Kristina and Taysir; its creation manifested her spark.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Ravidel used to threaten the gathering.

entities.name: Treaty of the Shard
entities.description: Agreement forged by Kristina and later broken.

events.summary: Kristina meets and falls in love with Taysir; they are trapped in the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.
events.quote: They were trapped in the Shard of the Twelve Worlds after its formation

events.summary: Kristina destroys the elder dragon Leshrac summoned.
Kristina leaves Taysir; he banishes Sandruu, her new love.
events.quote: An enraged Taysir found out and banished Sandruu

events.summary: Kristina saves Jared Carthalion, teaches him and becomes his lover.
events.quote: She taught him how to use his magic and later became his lover

events.summary: Jared ascends as a planeswalker, saving the wounded Kristina from Ravidel; they have a daughter, Justina.
events.quote: saved by Jared when he ascended and became a planeswalker

events.summary: Kristina becomes one of the Nine Titans and is killed on Phyrexia by Tevesh Szat.
events.quote: She was "accidentally" killed on Phyrexia by Tevesh Szat

relations.quote: she met and fell in love with Taysir
she again fell in love, this time with the minotaur planeswalker Sandruu
later became his lover just after his sixteenth birthday
killed on Phyrexia by Tevesh Szat
Kristina became one of the Nine Titans
